newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: RUGBY UNION-ENGLAND CAN GET BETTER, WARNS ROWELL.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-ENGLAND CAN GET BETTER, WARNS ROWELL.

text.p: England coach Jack Rowell issued a warning to Five Nations rivals France after Saturday's record 46-6 drubbing of Ireland, suggesting his team could conquer even greater heights.
England are set to meet the French at Twickenham on March 1 in an encounter which should settle the destiny of this season's Five Nations championship, and Rowell is looking forward to the challenge.

"Some of the things we spoke of during the week like keeping our shape and keeping control of the ball we didn't always do," Rowell said. "But we are getting better as a team and we can improve further."
The result represented a second successive record win for England, but Rowell's delight was not shared by his former coaching colleague at English club champions Bath, Brian Ashton.

"Ireland are playing catch-up with the top nations. That performance today was naive," said Ashton, Ireland's coaching advisor. "I'm just delighted England didn't do what they did towards the end from the first minute."
